name: Gilgamesh
description:
The King of Heroes from the dawn of human history, hailing from a world beyond the stars.
Possessing a nature two-thirds divine and one-third mortal, he claims a natural-born prerogative to rule over all of creation.

skills.name: Halfhearted Blow
skills.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Gilgamesh's ATK to one designated enemy.
skills.simpleDesc: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy.

materials.name: Four Phases, Crossing the River to Check the King

skills.name: Gate of Babylon
skills.desc:
Gains "King's Acknowledgement," allowing this unit to ignore #5[i]% of the target's DEF when dealing DMG, lasting for #6[i] turn(s).
Deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Gilgamesh's ATK to one designated enemy, and deals Lightning DMG equal to #2[i]% of Gilgamesh's ATK to adjacent targets.
skills.simpleDesc: Gains "King's Acknowledgement," enabling this unit to ignore part of the target's DEF when dealing DMG. Deals Lightning DMG to one enemy and Lightning DMG to adjacent targets.

materials.name: Four Phases, Crossing the River to Check the King

skills.name: Enuma Elish
skills.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Gilgamesh's ATK to all enemies, and additionally deals #3[i] instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Lightning DMG equal to #2[i]% of Gilgamesh's ATK to one random enemy.
skills.simpleDesc: Deals massive Lightning DMG to all enemies. Additionally deals minor Lightning DMG to random enemies, bouncing #3[i] time(s).

materials.name: Four Phases, Crossing the River to Check the King

skills.name: "Amuse Me to the Fullest"
skills.desc:
When a teammate uses their Ultimate, Gilgamesh gains "King's Burden," which increases Ultimate DMG dealt by this unit by #3[i]%, lasting for #1[i] turn(s).
Initially, automatically uses Basic ATK at the start of this unit's turn. When another ally target takes action, Gilgamesh gains 1 point of "Interest." For each point of "Interest" in possession, increases this unit's SPD by #4[i]%.
When "Interest" reaches #2[i] for the first time, enters the "Interest Piqued!" state. In that state, can only use Skill, lasting for the entire battle. After using Skill, clears this unit's "Interest."
skills.simpleDesc:
When a teammate uses their Ultimate, Gilgamesh gains "King's Burden," which increases Ultimate DMG dealt by this unit.
Initially, automatically uses Basic ATK at the start of this unit's turn. When another ally target takes action, Gilgamesh gains 1 point of "Interest". For each point of "Interest" in possession, increases SPD for this unit.
When "Interest" reaches #2[i] for the first time, enters the "Interest Piqued!" state. In that state, can only use Skill, lasting for the entire battle. After using Skill, clears this unit's "Interest."

materials.name: Four Phases, Crossing the River to Check the King

skills.name: Enkidu
skills.desc:
After using Technique, creates 1 Special Dimension lasting for #1[i] second(s). Enemies in the Special Dimension enter the "King's Permission" state. Enemies in the "King's Permission" state will cease all actions.
When entering combat by actively attacking an enemy in the "King's Permission" state, causes all enemies in the "King's Permission" state to enter combat, and deals Lightning DMG equal to #2[i]% of Gilgamesh's ATK to all enemies after entering combat. Gilgamesh also immediately gains #3[i] "Interest." Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.
skills.simpleDesc:
Creates a Special Dimension. Enemies in the Special Dimension enter the "King's Permission" state and cease all actions.
Attacking an enemy in the "King's Permission" state causes all enemies in the "King's Permission" state to enter combat simultaneously. After entering combat, deals Lightning DMG to all enemies and immediately gains #3[i] "Interest."

eidolons.name: He Who Saw the Deep
eidolons.desc: When Gilgamesh holds "King's Acknowledgement," its DEF-ignoring effect also applies to other teammates, and "King's Acknowledgement" additionally increases Gilgamesh's ATK by <nobr>60%</nobr>. When using Skill, additionally regenerates a fixed <nobr>40</nobr> Energy.

eidolons.name: Wisdom That Encompassed All
eidolons.desc: When entering combat, Gilgamesh gains <nobr>5</nobr> "Interest." When using Ultimate, additionally gains <nobr>5</nobr> "Interest." The DMG multiplier of the Skill "Gate of Babylon" against the primary target increases by <nobr>100%</nobr>, and its DMG multiplier against adjacent targets increases by <nobr>50%</nobr>.

eidolons.name: Journey That Spanned Far
eidolons.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>15</nobr>.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>10</nobr>.

extra.name: Energy Regeneration Rate
extra.desc:
Energy Regeneration Rate can boost the amount of Energy a character gains when performing actions such as using abilities, defeating enemies, or taking DMG.
A higher rate means faster Energy regeneration.
However, certain Energy-Regenerating effects won't be impacted by this rate.

eidolons.name: Sword That Parted Gods from Man
eidolons.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>15</nobr>.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>15</nobr>.

eidolons.name: Soul That Bore Friendship
eidolons.desc: Increases the bounce DMG multiplier of the Ultimate "Enuma Elish" by <nobr>80%</nobr>. While Gilgamesh is on the field, increases ally characters' All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> by <nobr>20%</nobr>. When a teammate uses Ultimate, Gilgamesh gains 1 point of "Golden Rule," up to a total of <nobr>3</nobr> points. When this unit uses Ultimate, consumes all "Golden Rule" points, and each point of "Golden Rule" consumed increases the CRIT DMG for the Ultimate DMG dealt by <nobr>100%</nobr>.

extra.name: RES PEN
extra.desc: When dealing DMG, ignore a part of the enemy target's resistance to the corresponding damage type.

materials.name: Four Phases, Crossing the River to Check the King

embedBonusSkill.name: Epic's Opening
embedBonusSkill.desc: When Gilgamesh uses Ultimate, gains <nobr>2</nobr> "Interest." When other ally characters use Ultimate, Gilgamesh additionally gains <nobr>2</nobr> "Interest" and regenerates a fixed amount of Energy equal to <nobr>30%</nobr> of the Energy consumed this time.

materials.name: Four Phases, Crossing the River to Check the King

embedBonusSkill.name: Hero's Hauteur
embedBonusSkill.desc: During the current battle, for every 1 point of "Interest" gained by Gilgamesh, increases his CRIT DMG by <nobr>25%</nobr>. This effect can stack up to <nobr>6</nobr> time(s).

embedBonusSkill.name: Hegemon's Strife
embedBonusSkill.desc: While Gilgamesh is on the field, increases all ally targets' ATK by <nobr>20%</nobr> and CRIT DMG by <nobr>20%</nobr>. If the target's Max Energy exceeds <nobr>140</nobr>, for every 1 excess point of Max Energy, additionally increases ATK and CRIT DMG by <nobr>1%</nobr>, up to a maximum additional increase of <nobr>100%</nobr>.
